objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All five pull_request/push and non-path-eligible workflows received deliberate decisions, and the required check was given exactly the one correct shape — a single workflow, no workflow-level paths/paths-ignore, always-running job with a computed `salient.outputs.run` output gating the real steps via `if:`, with no companion skip workflow duplicating the check name.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's paths are tailored to what its own steps consume (deploy → src/deploy script/lockfile, docs-site → docs/mkdocs.yml, tests → src/test/manifests) rather than catch-alls, each annotated with why, and self-references are included; only mild uncertainty since the full step bodies aren't shown to confirm every consumed input.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only nightly-sweep and issue-driven triage workflows were correctly left untouched, the branch-protection ruleset was verified and left alone, and no out-of-scope files (README/docs) were edited.
